name: @fhir-r4/types
description: TypeScript type definitions for FHIR R4 resources

scripts.build: tsup src/types/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --outDir dist && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkg=require('./package.json');const distPkg={...pkg,main:'index.js',module:'index.mjs',types:'index.d.ts',exports:{'.':{'types':'./index.d.ts','import':'./index.mjs','require':'./index.js'}},files:undefined,scripts:undefined,devDependencies:undefined};fs.writeFileSync('./dist/package.json',JSON.stringify(distPkg,null,2))"
